description:
Free. Turns a US street address into a latitude/longitude plus the state, county and census tract it is in (with GEOIDs), using the U.S. Census Bureau geocoder. Use it first, then pass the point to the paid property tools.

One-line address to point, with the Census Bureau's own match: the matched address, ZIP code, coordinates and the state, county and tract containing them. An address the geocoder cannot place is reported as not found, never guessed. US addresses only; PO boxes and rural routes often do not match.

When to use: Use when you have a US street address and need its coordinates, county or census tract. Free. flood_zone, hazard_history and address_profile also accept the address directly, so call this only when the user wants the location itself.

This tool is free and does not consume plan credits.

Every response includes a sources[] array naming the data origin and licence.

address.description: A US street address, e.g. "411 Legislative Ave, Dover, DE 19901".
